dedupe_keys.name: data and results of eelib simulations for the user based multi use of battery storage systems

description: This Zenodo release contains eELib model configurations, a Python scenario script, an evaluation notebook and HDF5 results for battery multi-use in multi-family buildings. Coverage is site-scale multi-family building scenarios. The provider identifies average-building and MELANI configurations with static, dynamic-charging and fully dynamic user allocation, with or without battery storage. Three JSON configuration files are openly listed alongside larger archives under CC BY 4.0. The materials can test how allocating photovoltaic and battery capabilities among households changes self-consumption or grid interaction. The general eELib model is already catalogued; this is a distinct scenario and results package. A limitation is that the landing page does not list building location, tariff assumptions, load data or HDF5 variable schema. Results are simulated, not observed household operation, and the release notes warn that scenario syntax depends on code versions. The source files and archives were not downloaded or executed, and no benefit of one allocation rule was verified.
